observations:
Torah 71 is a tightly unified teaching with two good packages and one evil counterpart. All the conceptual domains in the text are fully covered by the three existing packages:

1. Package 1 (נועם / מוחין של ארץ ישראל) covers the entire domain of pleasant, harmonious, generative consciousness — including the roles of יוסף, the שלהובין דרחימותא, the procreative imagery (שפרה, הולדה), and the quality of pleasantness in Torah study.

2. Package 2 (צדקה / יעקב) covers the vessel-making domain — generosity of heart, the open-hearted giving that creates the receptacle for נועם.

3. Package 3 (חובלים / מוחין של חוץ לארץ) covers the negative domain of discordant minds damaged by פגם הכבוד.

The concept of כבוד (the Glory of God) functions throughout as the GOAL and PURPOSE of the entire Torah — all packages flow toward it via eitza — but כבוד itself does not form an independent bechina cluster of 3+ nodes within this Torah. It is the destination, not a thematic cluster. The verse 'ובהיכלו כולו אומר כבוד' describes כבוד as the output of the Heichal, not a parallel domain.

The כ"ח אתוון דמעשה בראשית and עשרה מאמרות are mentioned in passing as a gloss on the 'כח' required to stand in the Heichal — they do not form a cluster of 3+ nodes connected by explicit bechina language.

The הולדה / procreation theme is already fully represented within Package 1 (שפרה, שפיר ושליא, הולדה, שלהובין דרחימותא) and does not constitute an independent package — it is the functional output of the נועם domain rather than a separate thematic family.

Conclusion: the three existing packages (good/נועם, good/צדקה, evil/חובלים) are complete and sufficient to represent the conceptual topology of Torah 71. No new packages are warranted.
